items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I mean she is my idol and was a very strong influence

ctx.x: Didn’t somebody early on — I don’t know if it was very early in your career — someone made some comparison to Ella Fitzgerald with you. And I thought that was so unfair. Like why do you take that off as a starting point.

Yeah it’s like come on, I’m 20. I mean she is my idol and was a very strong influence, but everybody has to compare everything to something else. Nothing new comes along without the press telling all the listeners, okay, it’s similar to this thing. So if you like that thing you’ll like this. If not, look elsewhere. I mean nobody just says okay here’s the new person check it out and decide for yourself. That’s just not what happens. I mean and there’s already, I mean when I first started out I was compared to…
Well that’s sort of what I was wondering about.
